title: The basic Control node contains a child node called ColorRect. If you set the Control node property to ClipChildren=Only, the child node ColorRect will not be clipped.
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.stable.mono.official [876b29033]

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8157) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12400 (12 threads) - 15.79 GiB memory

### Issue description

The basic Control node contains a child node, ColorRect. Setting the Control node's property ClipChildren=Only prevents the child ColorRect from being clipped. However, if ColorRect1 contains a child node, ColorRect2, setting ColorRect1's property ClipChildren=Only will cause the child node to be clipped. Does this mean that setting ClipChildren=Only on the Control node itself has no effect?

### Steps to reproduce
